origin: Discovered while qualifying N31. U1's split MCP resolver inherited parent-first PATHEXT lookup from historical ledger commit c1f8af1e86bdced8ede9a6c09e0fffd2dfe100bb (historical_ledger_reaudit.jsonl:922) and a later configured-PATHEXT helper from faceb453374043da2a38ed3c4981dd8190fdceac (:1077). The downstream-only .exe shim preference came from 854abafca4bbeae162aad5b4a0ab40a8fe015628. N32 resolves their collision in the actual Windows integration; it is not a claim that U1 already fixed this behavior.
final_observable_contract: For a bare Windows MCP stdio command, a child PATH hit chosen under an explicitly configured PATHEXT wins over an executable found using the parent PATHEXT and is not replaced by a sibling .exe. Windows case-insensitive config keys override inherited environment keys and PATH/PATHEXT have one canonical spelling in the child environment. With no explicit override, the fork's usual .exe preference remains.
source_span: Before N32, tools/mcp_tool.py:1061-1077 searched with parent PATHEXT first and only tried the child extension list on a miss; :1120 then unconditionally replaced a selected .cmd with a sibling .exe
tools/mcp_tool.py:735-778 now merges Windows child environment keys case-insensitively and canonicalizes PATH/PATHEXT
tools/mcp_tool.py:1064-1147 now selects an explicit child extension hit before parent lookup and exempts that selected path from the fork's .exe shim preference
MCPServerTask._run_stdio at tools/mcp_tool.py:3264-3339 passes explicit-config presence and forwards the selected command/environment to StdioServerParameters
tests/tools/test_n32_mcp_pathext_precedence.py:25-148 and updated N31 concurrency test verify the native Windows resolver and caller boundary
red_receipt: On product parent 7f962e576df514745582dcb6af9ebf55921df543, side-by-side n32_server.exe and n32_server.cmd under the child PATH with parent PATHEXT=.EXE and child PATHEXT=.CMD caused two N32 tests to fail: both direct resolution and the actual stdio caller selected .exe. The default .exe-preference control passed. The independent review found a second caller defect: config env using Pathext or path/pathext preserved duplicate case-insensitive keys or left PATH unresolved. Two new native caller cases failed before correction. No real MCP server was launched for RED.

Keep the existing .exe GUI preference when no child PATHEXT override was explicitly configured
Verify actual _run_stdio parameter handoff and case-insensitive Windows environment overlay
Run affected native tests and deliberate mutations, refresh separate D0/U1/integration CodeGraph indexes, obtain read-only independent rereview, and bind exact product commit blobs
